messages:
Maya S.: quick heads-up — zephyrlite-v2-int4 canary (canary-id: cz-21) shows ~2% funcall parse failures in the last hour.
Axel: ugh. are these parse failures from non-json suffixes or truncated streams?
Maya S.: looks like truncated JSON suffixes after a retry. telemetry: parse_fail_rate=0.021, retry_rate=0.034. sample attached below.
Jon C.: paste logs:
```
INVOKE id=abc123 model=zephyrlite-v2-int4
RESP chunk1: {
  "tool": "search",
  "args": { "q": "kittens" }
}
RESP chunk2: {"meta": "..."
<socket disconnect>
parse_error: unexpected EOF
retries: 1 (runtime resumed)
```
Zara: runtime is auto-retrying on transport reads; guess it's replaying the toolcall when it resumes causing duplicate tool invocations.
Maya S.: exactly — duplicates + truncated suffix means parser sees two fragments and sometimes gets non-terminated JSON.
Axel: what's current retry policy? only on 5xx or on read timeouts too?
Jon C.: config: retry_on = [NET_ERROR, READ_TIMEOUT, 5xx], max_retries=2. No idempotency enforced at tool layer.
Maya S.: proposals:
- short term: disable read-time retries for funcall-enabled routes in canary
- add sentinel suffix token ("\n<<END>>\n") emission on model output when model completes JSON
- add idempotency token for tool invocation so backend can dedupe
- postprocess fixer that stitches partial json when suffix missing (best-effort)
Axel: agree. can we deploy sentinel quickly? should be low-risk for canary only.
Zara: I can ship sentinel in runtime within the hour for canary stream config flag. will need model-side prompt tweak to prefer emitting sentinel.
Maya S.: also want to add an eval to measure "duplicate-toolcall rate" and "parse-fix success rate" post-change.
deploy-bot: Canary cz-21: rolling patch to runtime (sentinel stream flag) scheduled at 1717005000.
canary-bot: Canary cz-21 metrics snapshot: parse_fail_rate=0.021 -> target <0.005 after fixes.
Jon C.: I'll add an idempotency header to the toolcall wrapper in client lib, and a backoff change to not retry after partial stream. PR incoming.
Axel: make sure billing telemetry marks deduped tool calls so customers aren't double-charged in the meantime.
Maya S.: thanks team. next steps: Zara runtime patch -> Jon client PR -> rerun canary and post-results here. tagging infra to watch for unintended latency changes.
Zara: starting deploy now.
Jon C.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/clients/pull/3327
Maya S.: will follow with sample diffs once new canary runs finish. :thumbsup:
